integrity: The infinite statement is proved symbolically from Parseval and the primitive integer collision relation. Exact finite enumeration is corroborative only. Literature comparisons distinguish the new arbitrary-gap formula and inverse consequence from prior special-support and L-infinity results.
scientific_limitations: Unimodular three-term Fourier sums on the one-dimensional torus only. The all-even-moment polynomial is exact, but higher-resonance minimization for r >= 2B is not classified. The special {0,1,N} collision threshold is prior work and is excluded from the originality claim.
title: Even phase moments recover the normalized geometry of a three-frequency spectrum
